ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This section is reserved for non-degree seeking students. Go to the following URL: https://courses.las.illinois.edu to access the Moodle course management system login page. Undergraduate students should take course for 3 credit hours and Graduate students should take course for 4 credit hours. Undergrads sign up for 3 hours; grads sign up for 4 hours. Instructor's email address: dickrson@illinois.edu
